lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance blobs arranged in roughly four horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits. The second row from the dorsal ridge contains the largest and most widely spaced circular clusters, while the lower rows exhibit smaller, higher-density clusters progressing towards the ventral surface.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with high-luminance blobs along the mid-lateral flank, creating a grid-like configuration where blobs serve as nodes at the intersections of horizontal and vertical gradients.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance shift (high intensity above, low intensity shadow below) extending from the dorsal margin of the gills towards the posterior.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 7-9 high-luminance blobs are visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, showing a sparse and irregular distribution compared to the lateral flank constellation.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits an exceptionally high density of small-diameter, high-luminance blobs compared to the primary torso patterning.
